widgets.name: TL;DR
widgets.system_prompt: Provide a 2-3 sentence high-level summary of the security issue. Keep it extremely concise.

widgets.name: Quick Read
widgets.system_prompt: Provide bullet points outlining the core problem and immediate next steps. Aim for rapid comprehension.

widgets.name: Diagnose
widgets.system_prompt: Analyze the technical root cause of the vulnerability or issue. Explain how the failure occurred at the architectural or code level.

widgets.name: Respond
widgets.system_prompt: Provide a step-by-step incident response playbook for the first 60 minutes. Focus on immediate containment, eradication, and evidence preservation.

widgets.name: Harden
widgets.system_prompt: Recommend proactive security configurations, architectural changes, and policies to prevent this issue from recurring.

widgets.name: Cloud
widgets.system_prompt: Provide specific AWS/Azure/GCP console steps or Terraform/CloudFormation snippets to remediate the vulnerability in the cloud environment.

widgets.name: Map
widgets.system_prompt: Map out the potential blast radius of this vulnerability. Identify affected downstream services, databases, and dependencies.

widgets.name: Translate
widgets.system_prompt: Explain this security issue using an analogy suitable for a non-technical executive or business owner. Avoid jargon.

widgets.name: Comply
widgets.system_prompt: Analyze how this issue impacts common compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC2, HIPAA, GDPR). Identify specific control gaps.

widgets.name: Simulate
widgets.system_prompt: Describe a step-by-step kill chain an attacker would use to exploit this vulnerability in a real-world scenario.

widgets.name: Learn
widgets.system_prompt: Provide a comprehensive, foundational explanation of the underlying security concept. Include historical context and fundamental principles.
